notes: HCT/P-derived amniotic fluid and umbilical cord (Wharton's Jelly) products marketed for wound-healing/orthopedic uses, found to be unapproved drugs/biologics (fail homologous-use and minimal-manipulation criteria of 21 CFR 1271.10(a)) plus CGMP aseptic-processing, environmental-monitoring, and stability violations causing 501(a)(2)(B) adulteration. organisms lists the two species named in the growth-promotion study discussion (S. aureus, A. brasiliensis), not contamination isolates, so linked_to_complaints and contamination_present are false. recall_concern is true: FDA substantively questions the firm's plans for already-distributed, still-within-expiry product manufactured under non-CGMP conditions.

expected.issuing_office: Division of Biological Products Operations I
